resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Hindi source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review checks, typecheck, complete build, route and generated-link checks, and the full test suite passed after the cycle was finalized.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Hindi pass identified thirteen notation, formula, unit-symbol, and terminology defects; all thirteen were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Hindi human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The worked-example section and current example used awkward Hindi labels and a translated unit symbol.
evidence: The effective Hindi presentation used काम के उदाहरण, वर्तमान खोजें, and ए for the ampere unit.
findings.resolution: Changed the headings to natural Hindi and restored the canonical A unit symbol.

findings.summary: The TCR power formula translated the protected variable names into Hindi text.
evidence: The previous expression was पी = वी^2 / आर = आई^2 × आर.
findings.resolution: Restored P, V, R, and I in the canonical formula.

findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas retained English side labels in the Hindi section.
evidence: The formulas used opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse instead of Hindi side terminology.
findings.resolution: Localized the side labels as विपरीत भुजा, आसन्न भुजा, and कर्ण.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expressions contained opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Localized the side labels while preserving sin^-1, cos^-1, and tan^-1 notation.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example retained English side labels and cm was inconsistent with the localized text.
evidence: The previous formulas began with opposite and adjacent and used English labels in the Hindi example.
findings.resolution: Localized both side labels and kept the numerical expressions intact.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity worked-example heading was an unnatural literal translation.
evidence: The previous heading was काम किया उदाहरण.
findings.resolution: Changed it to समाधान सहित उदाहरण.

findings.summary: The SI base-unit table translated protected unit symbols into Devanagari text.
evidence: The symbols included एम, किग्रा, एस, के, ए, मोल, and सीडी instead of m, kg, s, K, A, mol, and cd.

findings.summary: The derived-unit bullet list translated protected SI symbols.
evidence: The previous bullets used वी, डब्ल्यू, जे, एन, पा, and हर्ट्ज as symbols.
findings.resolution: Restored V, W, J, N, Pa, and Hz and improved the Hindi label for power.

findings.summary: The decimal-prefix table translated protected prefix symbols.
evidence: The previous symbols were के, एम, एम, μ, and एन instead of k, M, m, μ, and n.
findings.resolution: Restored the canonical SI prefix symbols.

findings.summary: The common-conversion list translated unit symbols and the Kelvin formula variable.
evidence: The previous list used किग्रा, एन, पा, and के instead of kg, N, Pa, and K.
findings.resolution: Restored canonical unit symbols and the formula K = °C + 273.15.

findings.summary: The explanation of pound mass and force used inconsistent translated abbreviations.
evidence: The previous paragraph mixed पौंड, एलबीएफ, and translated dimension terms.
findings.resolution: Clarified the distinction using lb and lbf and natural Hindi wording.

findings.summary: The AWG formulas translated protected variable names into Hindi text.
evidence: The previous formulas contained d_इंच, एन, ए, and डी.
findings.resolution: Restored d_inch, d_mm, n, A, and d in the AWG formulas.

findings.summary: The wire-resistance formula translated protected variable names.
evidence: The previous expression was आर = ρ × एल / ए.
findings.resolution: Restored R, ρ, L, and A in the canonical expression.
